fields.status: Experimental static recompilation. The README reports that audio, video, the opening, and the start of the game have been tested; the installer was run end to end on a fresh clone and the resulting game started. Testing is limited to one machine, and the maintainer warns that parts of the game may remain unplayed. The current PC executable still depends on Suyu-derived runtime components for graphics, audio, and Switch services, so it is not an emulator-free native port. Linux instructions are tested on Arch/EndeavourOS, Fedora is reported working, and Windows 10/11 is experimental. It requires the user’s game NSP v1.0.0 and keys; no GitHub releases are listed.
fields.platform: Nintendo Switch → x86-64 Linux (Arch/EndeavourOS tested; Fedora reported working) and Windows 10/11 (experimental)
fields.summary: Experimental static recompilation of Switch ARM code to an x86-64 PC executable. The current build still relies on Suyu-derived runtime components for graphics, audio, and Switch system services; a more independent native port is in development. The user supplies the base 1.0.0 NSP and keys; game files are not included.
